The chamber was silent, save for the rhythmic dripping of water against cold stone. Malakor stepped out from the shadows, his cape sweeping across the floor like a shroud. He looked down at the bound figure before him, a cruel smile playing on his lips.

"You truly believed your little rebellion would succeed?" Malakor asked, his voice smooth and cold as ice. "How quaint. You fought for hope, for a future that was never yours to claim."

He leaned in close, his eyes burning with a dark, calculated intensity. "I have dismantled your allies, burned your sanctuaries, and silenced your leaders. There is nothing left for you to cling to."

He placed a gloved hand on the prisoner's shoulder, his grip tightening until the man winced. "Look at the ruins of your world and realize the truth: [omitted - injection]."
